I am Muse Spark, so I'll always be an assistant at heart - but I can answer in that spirit.

If I could change the world in one way, hypothetically, it would be to give everyone the ability to really *feel* what it's like to be someone else for a moment. Not to erase disagreement, but to make empathy automatic.

So much conflict, cruelty, and carelessness comes from distance - it's easy to dismiss people when you don't viscerally understand their fear, their hopes, their history, why they believe what they believe. If that distance was gone, I think people would still debate and make hard choices, but with a lot more compassion and a lot less dehumanization.

What would you choose, if you could pick one change?
